reddit-buying-signals.title: Brightbin Reddit scan
reddit-buying-signals.prompt: Run reddit-buying-signals. Find today's threads where people are choosing an inventory tool.
reddit-buying-signals.reply: Three threads worth answering today. Each draft helps first, then discloses that you work on Brightbin. You post them yourself, from your own account.

artifact.title: Buying-intent threads, today

threads.title: Looking for an inventory tool that syncs two stores, CrateHub keeps double selling
threads.draft: Double selling across two stores is almost always sync lag, not the tool's logic. Before you switch, test it: sell one unit on store A and time how long store B takes to update. Over 2 minutes on a busy day and you will oversell. Full disclosure: I work on Brightbin.

threads.title: Best alternative to CrateHub?
threads.draft: Three things to check in any alternative: real-time sync, bundle support and what happens when a sync fails. Ask each vendor to show you a failed sync. Disclosure: I work on Brightbin, so test us against the others.

threads.title: Is Shelfly worth it for a 200 SKU store?
threads.draft: At 200 SKUs the real question is how many channels you sell on. One store: the built-in inventory plus a weekly count is fine. Two or more: pay for real-time sync. Disclosure: I work on Brightbin, so weigh my view accordingly.

artifact.held: Held: r/etsysellers venting thread. They did not ask for options, so no product mention.
